name: [NEW MAP] Takeover
desc:
This game is best if played on PC or Console (V1.4)

CONTROLS
W - Gas
S - Brakes
P - Hand Brake
M - Transmission Controls
T - Traction Control
Y - Anti-Lock Braking System
Left Control - Nitrous

In a world where your destined to be the greatest, Takeover is a open world free roam car experience that allows you to race friends, Roleplay,  and spectate the horizon while driving, You can modify all of your cars with in depth customization with nearly no limitations, Strive to be the fastest and also the greatest.
